create_task.entry: createCommandToolInterface(action task.create).prepare -> approval_required ApprovalProposal; execute after approval through the durable command executor (/clio/tools/create_task). apps/control/action-followthrough already prepares task drafts from action items.

create_task.approval: immutable proposal (action-application approve or conversation approval.wait)

update_task.entry: createCommandToolInterface(action task.update).prepare -> approval_required; unconditional 0.2 patch, no compare-and-swap

save_memory.approval: immutable proposal; canonical memory review remains authoritative

save_chat_attachments.entry: createCommandToolInterface(action artifact.file).prepare -> approval_required; source call resolves exact attachment objects through the trusted resolveAttachments broker
save_chat_attachments.approval: immutable proposal for the exact destination
